A domain's primary off-site copy can follow a destination, the same way an additional target made from one does ([#319](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/319)).

## ✨ Added

- **Use a destination for the primary copy.** Below each domain's off-site field, Settings, Off-site has a **Use** button for every destination the domain does not copy to yet. It moves the primary copy into the domain's folder under that destination, after the same question a typed location asks.
- **The destination decides, the field shows it.** A primary that follows a destination takes the destination's name, sign-in, storage class and immutable switch, and the destination lists the domain under **Used by**. The field shows the location locked. **Type a location** unlocks it, and saving a hand-typed location ends the link. Retention stays on the Retention page.
- **Append-only stays in step.** Switching append-only on or off for a destination carries over to the primary that follows it, and a settings page that was already open cannot switch it back.

## 🎨 Changed

- **Taking over a primary keeps it in the field.** **Take over** under **Already under this destination** leaves a domain's primary in its off-site field, where it follows the destination. The field is no longer emptied and the target stays out of the list of additional targets.

## 🌐 Translations

- The new buttons and messages in all 42 languages, and the destination section of the off-site and recovery page in all 26 documentation languages.

## Upgrading

- **Nothing has to be changed.** A primary that was taken over before this version stays where it is, in the list of additional off-site targets.
